label: Bible Study
prompt: And the LORD God planted a _____ eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
verse: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
note: The first real estate in Scripture — a garden 'eastward in Eden,' planted by God himself.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to _____, and of great mercy.
verse: The LORD is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.
note: Gracious, compassionate, slow to anger, great in mercy — God's character sheet, echoing Exodus 34:6.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But withal prepare me also a _____: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
verse: But withal prepare me also a lodging: for I trust that through your prayers I shall be given unto you.
note: Paul ends his note to Philemon hopeful of release: get a lodging ready for me.

label: Deep Water
prompt: _____ the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
verse: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.
note: Psalm 2's warning to rebellious kings: pay homage to God's anointed Son before his anger flares.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For whom the LORD loveth he _____; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
verse: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son in whom he delighteth.
note: Correction as a love language: 'whom the LORD loveth he correcteth' — as a father the son he delights in.
